name: National Assembly of Malawi
notes: Unicameral legislature of Malawi; 229 constituency seats since the 16 September 2025 election. No Seats chart: the Assembly's own site gave no member list that could be read, and the press tallies of the Electoral Commission results (DPP about 78, independents about 70-73, MCP 52-53, UTM 8, UDF 4, AFORD 3, PP 3, three single-seat parties) disagree and leave 5 seats undeclared, so they do not add up to 229. No supporter sits.
